title: Every field an outsider wrote in one row of the store
description: The body of an ingestion.text log record: the outsider-written fields of one store row, as JSON. It carries the same ingestion.record.kind, ingestion.record.id and ingestion.record.version attributes as the ingestion.record holding the rest of that row, so a reader granted both joins them on those three. A row with no outsider-written field ships no ingestion.text. A reader that must never meet outsider text is granted ingestion.record alone.

title.description: The artifact's title, as its source gave it.

external_key.description: The connector's own key for the artifact, such as a canonical URL or a post's id.

fields.description: Values the connector read from the source's payload, by name, such as a Reddit save's subreddit, which a routing rule matches.

path.description: Where the file lives under its root.

outputs.title: outputs
outputs.description: A scan holds each finding's span. A model stage holds its answer, and the structure stage its profile. A failed output holds its error. A parse's text is in parse_units.

text.description: Null. A parse's text is its parse_units rows joined by a blank line.

units.description: Null. A parse's units are rows of parse_units.

spans.description: Each finding's matched text: item i is the span of finding i in the ingestion.record of the same kind, id and version.

answer.description: A model stage's structured answer, whole, as the stage's schema holds it. The quality gate answers prompts/quality/answer.schema.json: genre, domains, themes, quality, a one-line idea, a verdict and a side, each with its confidence. A model read answers a summary, a suggestion sentence, or both. The structure stage answers a PDF's profile: its pages, each outline entry's level, title and page, its page-label rules, its metadata's creationDate, and the shares of every fifth page set in monospace and in TeX or math fonts.

error.description: Why the output failed, such as an extractor's stderr or the run's failure, or why a waiting model stage's dispatch has not started, in the dispatch service's words.

parse_units.title: parse_units
parse_units.description: One unit of a parse, such as a thread's post or comment or a book's page. A parse's whole text is its units' text in the order of n, joined by a blank line.

label.description: The unit's own heading, such as a comment's author or a chapter's title.

sections.title: sections
sections.description: One entry of an item's sections. Its title is the outline entry's as the PDF writes it, trimmed.

topics.title: topics
topics.description: One topic of a memo, as a model named it over the memo's transcript.

title.description: The topic's title, which its item takes too.

idea.description: The topic's idea in one sentence.

last_error.description: The destination's answer to the last write that failed, what a refusal names, or why the delivery was withdrawn.

title.description: The item's title when the delivery was first queued, which every attempt sends.

url.description: The item's URL when the delivery was first queued, which every attempt sends.

path.description: For a deliverer that writes an item by its file, the path of the item's live home below the root that the deliverer's config names, when the delivery was first queued, which every attempt sends. Null for every other deliverer. Absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

position.description: Where the connector's next poll reads from, as its source wrote it, such as a page token or a feed entry's id. It moves only once a poll lands everything it found. Absent from a record shipped before it left on this channel.

last_error.description: Why the connector's newest run failed, such as a folder scan's error naming the files it could not land, or a poll's refusal of an arrival.

match_values.description: The values of match_field that the rule holds for, each matched exactly, and empty where it names no field. Each copies a source's field, such as a channel's name.
